name: Chole Bhature
steps: Soak chickpeas 8 hours, drain and cook with 700 ml fresh water and 7 g salt until tender, about 45–55 minutes. Reserve the liquid.
Mix flour, semolina, yogurt, baking powder, 20 ml oil, 4 g salt and remaining water into soft dough. Knead smooth, cover and rest 2 hours.

In remaining oil, toast cumin, cook onions golden, then fry ginger-garlic and tomatoes until thick. Add chole masala, turmeric, amchur, chickpeas, remaining salt and 300 ml cooking liquid; simmer 15 minutes.
Divide dough into 8 balls, roll into 15 cm ovals and fry one at a time in 185°C oil, pressing gently to puff; turn and brown briefly. Drain and serve with hot chole.
tips: A well-rested soft dough and fully hot oil help bhature puff without becoming greasy.
passiveTime: 8 hours chickpea soaking and 2 hours dough resting
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
